title: Empire Code Load Calc — contract v3.2 r2.1 closure (EC-CALC-2 / A3) — specification only, no engine exists
$comment: Rule basis NEC 2020 + NYC 2025 amendments. Validation layers: (1) strict JSON ingress, (2) this schema (structure + simple state couplings), (3) semantic input rules (problem codes), (4) contract invariant checker (contract_invariants_r2.py). JSON Schema does not prove load formulas.

rating.$comment: only kind='va' is computable; other kinds are accepted structurally so the engine reports UNSUPPORTED_RATING_KIND deterministically

coversEntry.$comment: basis-relevant projection of a covered load; label and legacy are descriptive-only and excluded

newLoadBasis.$comment: R-R1-04A: the tool applies no factor to precalculatedVA. An exact capacity verdict requires establishedForThisComparison=true (attestation that every applicable demand/continuous treatment is already inside the value); otherwise NEWLOAD_BASIS_UNQUALIFIED -> existingCapacity.not_assessed

coversSnapshot.$comment: R-R2-02: canonical projection of the covered loads at entry time — sorted by id (codepoint order), basis-relevant fields only; compared as canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace); any difference => AGGREGATE_STALE

newLoad.$comment: R-R1-04B/R-R2-02 coverage: mode=none is valid only when no retained load has status=new; precalculated lists the new loads it covers (covers[], no duplicates) and stores coversSnapshot (canonical projection) so any basis-relevant edit is detected (AGGREGATE_STALE)

value.$comment: R-R2-03: null = empty/unparsable form entry (adapter also reports parseErrors); never coerced to 0, never a previous value

readingScope.$comment: R-R1-03: what the reading represents; 'highest_loaded_conductor' means a single conductor value, never a total

sourceRecord.$comment: the raw v1 Favorites record, verbatim strings, kept whole

fieldMap.$comment: legacy field -> v3.2 path or null (kept raw only)

RequestEnvelope.$comment: R-R1-05 parser boundary: the adapter parses DOM strings into typed fields; anything it cannot parse stays null in the snapshot and is reported in parseErrors. The engine is a pure function of the envelope.

demandLine.$comment: R-R1-02/R-R2-01: every line is a typed equation checked EXACTLY (IEEE double, declared order) by contract_invariants_r21.py: identity; multiply result=operand*factor; divide_by_voltage result(A)=operand(VA)/divisorV; divide_by_sqrt3_voltage result(A)=operand(VA)/(sqrt3*divisorV); sum; convert_unit kVA->VA x1000, kW->VA (x1000)/powerFactor. divisorV is always a supply voltage taken from the envelope

existingCapacity.$comment: R-R1-01/03: verdicts compare RAW values (policy raw_conservative); adequate/inadequate only with comparisonKind=exact; upper_bound screening (if ever enabled) reports boundOutcome and never a verdict

requiredCapacity.$comment: R-R1-04C: no automatic Wire Sizer handoff in profile A; the actual consumer takes amperes (load/continuousLoad or continuousLoadA/noncontinuousLoadA)

finalResultHeading.$comment: true iff status COMPLETE (demand complete); it is NOT a verdict

verdictLabel.$comment: mirrors existingCapacity.status on COMPLETE; null otherwise
